title: Beyond No: Quantifying AI Over-Refusal and Emotional Attachment Boundaries
reasoning: The paper focuses on the ethical boundaries of AI personas and emotional attachment. It evaluates models based on their ability to navigate the ethical dilemma of anthropomorphism and avoid 'dishonest' emotional reciprocity while remaining helpful. The study is grounded in AI ethics literature and evaluates model behavior against ethical standards for boundary-setting and user well-being.
